name: desktop_screenshot
description: Capture a screenshot of the full desktop (or targeted Last War window). Returns a local path under .slack-agent/screenshots/. The agent can emit <<slack-file path="...">> (or the skill response suggests it) to trigger upload to the Slack thread. Requires the Slack app bot token to have the 'files:write' scope + reinstall. Requires BreakSandbox for the session.
